_comment: Desired Cloudflare state for webbsite.renavon.com, captured VERBATIM from live on 2026-09-16 so the first apply is a no-op and every rule keeps its id. This zone (renavon.com) is SHARED with other renavon hosts, so this file declares only the rules that reference this host (rule_scope) and never the zone's SSL mode or DNS: those are the zone owner's. Until the 2026-09 incident these rules existed only in the dashboard and in prose -- the load-bearing edge defence was versioned nowhere. Reconciled by site-deploy's cf-converge (dry-run by default; a root cf-converge@ unit holds CF_CONFIG_TOKEN, never gunicorn's env). The plan is renavon.com Free (5 WAF custom rules, 1 rate-limit rule); all five WAF slots are now used (the fifth by the 2026-09-27 direct-deep-URL challenge) and, with the single rate-limit rule, they are the constraints every change here works around until the Pro upgrade.

cache_rules.description: webbsite static assets - 7 day edge cache
webbsite CSV exports - 1 day edge cache
webbsite all pages - respect origin CDN-Cache-Control (long for historical)

waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "webbsite.renavon.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ccass/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/dbpub/")) and (http.referer eq "https://webbsite.renavon.com" or http.referer eq "https://webbsite.renavon.com/" or http.referer eq "http://webbsite.renavon.com" or http.referer eq "http://webbsite.renavon.com/") and http.request.uri.query ne "")
waf_custom_rules.description: webbsite: block forged bare-host Referer on /ccass + /dbpub deep URLs (distributed scraper signature)
waf_custom_rules._comment: The rule that ended the 2026-09-11 flood: the distributed scraper sent a bare-host Referer (https://webbsite.renavon.com with no path) on every deep URL, which no browser does. Widened from /ccass/ to /dbpub/ on 2026-09-16 while the site was still 521ing; it took origin-bound requests from ~200/s to ~3/s.

waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "webbsite.renavon.com" and (lower(http.user_agent) contains "semrushbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "ahrefsbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "mj12bot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "dotbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "petalbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "yandexbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "baiduspider" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "bytespider" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "gptbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "claudebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "ccbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "amazonbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "applebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "facebookexternalhit" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "meta-externalagent" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "perplexitybot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "diffbot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "blexbot"))
waf_custom_rules.description: webbsite: block aggressive SEO/AI scraper bots by user-agent

waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "webbsite.renavon.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ccass/") and http.request.uri.query ne "" and not (lower(http.user_agent) contains "mozilla" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "googlebot" or lower(http.user_agent) contains "bingbot"))
waf_custom_rules.description: webbsite: block deep /ccass URLs from non-browser user-agents

waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "webbsite.renavon.com" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ccass/") and http.request.uri.query ne "" and len(http.request.headers["accept-language"]) == 0)
waf_custom_rules.description: webbsite: managed challenge /ccass deep URLs missing accept-language header
waf_custom_rules._comment: Challenges any /ccass/ deep request with no Accept-Language. Real browsers always send one; python-requests does not, which is why tests/check_all_routes.py sets it explicitly. Widen to /dbpub/ only if the /dbpub/ rate limit (Pro plan) proves insufficient.

waf_custom_rules.expression: (http.host eq "webbsite.renavon.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/dbpub/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/ccass/")) and http.request.uri.query ne "" and http.referer eq "" and any(http.request.headers["sec-fetch-site"][*] eq "none") and not cf.client.bot)
waf_custom_rules.description: webbsite: managed challenge deep /dbpub + /ccass URLs opened directly (no Referer, Sec-Fetch-Site none; distributed scraper signature)
waf_custom_rules._comment: The 2026-09-26 crawl: ~35k distinct positions.asp?p= with a random sort=, from ~27k residential IPs, every URL unique so none hit the edge cache; it saturated gunicorn for hours (125k 502/504s, the uptime probe down). Every request claimed to be a browser navigating straight to the URL: no Referer and Sec-Fetch-Site: none, i.e. typed or pasted. Over 35 min of 2026-09-27 that was 27,808 of ~32k deep requests, against 5 carrying a same-site Referer. Humans reach deep pages by clicking (a same-origin Referer) or from a search engine (cross-site), so this only challenges a pasted or bookmarked deep link, and a managed challenge is usually passed without interaction; verified crawlers (cf.client.bot) are exempt so indexing is unaffected. Complements, not replaces, the origin fixes (PRs #55, #56). Takes the zone's last Free-plan WAF slot.

rate_limit_rules.description: webbsite ccass + samples.renavon.com bandwidth/scrape rate limit (Free-plan single rule)
rate_limit_rules._comment: SHARED with samples.renavon.com: the Free plan allows exactly one rate-limit rule per zone, so webbsite's /ccass/ limiter and renavon's samples limiter are one expression. Mentions another host, so under rule_scope this file reports it and does not touch it; on Pro, split it and add a /dbpub/ limiter (the flood's actual surface) here.
